sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was lowered: Q1 2026 transaction revenue guided to about $420M through 10 February, and subscription and services guided down to $550M-$630M on lower crypto prices, rates and rewards. The GAAP net loss of $667M driven by unrealized crypto losses and a $718M unrealized loss on the crypto portfolio add to the bearish tone. However, full-year volume and market share doubled year over year and expenses were held flat, preventing a more negative score.

summary.revenue: Q4 revenue $1.8B, down 5% quarter over quarter. Full-year 2025 revenue $7.2B, up 9%.

key_risks: Crypto market cap fell 11% in the quarter and the softness is reflected in the subscription guide.
Brief platform interruptions affected core buy, sell and transfer functions.
A $718M unrealized loss on the crypto portfolio plus $395M on strategic investments including Circle.
GAAP net loss $667M, driven by unrealized crypto losses.
key_opportunities: Global trading volume and market share both doubled year over year to all-time highs.
We store 12% of all crypto in the world, more than the next four competitors combined.
Q4 marked our ninth consecutive quarter of native unit inflows.
